meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调度一批互相依赖的子任务,按阶段依次执行,失败自动重试补救
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要让一大批有先后依赖的任务分成多个子任务按序跑完
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must fan out many interdependent tasks across child workers in order

howto.what: Claude 会通过原生 workflow 工具按依赖关系编排子任务,一个 run 只覆盖一个阶段,并在节点失败或跑偏时用 retry、send、amend 恢复,已完成节点的结果会保留。
howto.when: 当你要求 mass-ulw、给出任务 DAG,或需要存在真实依赖(某任务必须先等前序完成)的并行分派时触发。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这次发布拆成有依赖的 DAG 跑起来
say.note: 会先读 planning.md 再定义图

say.text: 重试失败的 verify 节点,并顺便改严它的 prompt
say.note: 只重跑该节点及其依赖者

say.text: 给正在跑的 audit 节点发消息,让它跳过 vendored 目录

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates dependency-ordered child tasks through the native workflow tool, one run per phase, recovering single nodes with retry, send, or amend while keeping completed results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for mass-ulw, give a task DAG, or need staged fan-out where some tasks must wait on others.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to run this release as a dependency-ordered DAG
say_en.note: Reads planning.md before defining the graph

say_en.text: Retry the failed verify node and tighten its prompt
say_en.note: Re-runs only that node and its dependents

say_en.text: Send a message to the running audit node to skip vendored dirs
